title: Nutty Dense Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A spicy and dense Saudi Arabian dish featuring sumac, perfect for kids and adults alike, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, sumac, olive oil, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, toast the chopped almonds in a small skillet over medium heat until fragrant.
Once the kebabs are done, brush them with the deglaze fond and sprinkle with toasted almonds.
Serve the kebabs in a copper mug with your choice of sides.
